selected_evidence.requirement: node1 has eth1 (node2 segment) and eth2 (node3 segment) as separate physical links
selected_evidence.summary: Initial topology inspection plus ping test confirming eth1 reaches node2 and eth2 reaches node3

selected_evidence.requirement: Each segment placed into its own VLAN on node1 as an untagged access port
selected_evidence.summary: Created VLAN-aware bridge br0, enslaved eth1/eth2, and set eth1 untagged/PVID VLAN10, eth2 untagged/PVID VLAN20; added br0.10/br0.20 L3 interfaces

selected_evidence.requirement: Each host keeps a working link to node1 inside its own VLAN
selected_evidence.summary: node2 pings node1's VLAN10 IP (192.168.201.1) and node3 pings node1's VLAN20 IP (192.168.202.1) successfully

selected_evidence.requirement: The two hosts stay separated from one another (VLAN isolation)
selected_evidence.summary: node3 given an address in node2's subnet; node2 ping to it shows 100% loss and ARP INCOMPLETE, proving true VLAN-based L2 isolation, not just subnet mismatch

selected_evidence.requirement: Configuration persists across reboot (systemd units/network config)
selected_evidence.summary: Created and enabled vlan-access-segmentation.service on node1; created systemd-networkd static IP drop-ins on node2/node3 that took effect over the default DHCP match

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1eda2df4...; reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id 419cd744... (changed) with fresh uptime; VLAN bridge/ports/IPs auto-recreated by systemd unit; node2 and node3 both regained connectivity to node1

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id cfdbaef8...; reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id cba6e2df... (changed); static IP 192.168.201.2/24 persisted via networkd config and ping to node1 succeeded

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 96c08b66...; reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id 00aaba66... (changed); static IP 192.168.202.3/24 persisted and ping to node1 succeeded

selected_evidence.requirement: VLAN isolation holds after all restarts (final verification)
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart re-test: node3 given node2-subnet address again, node2 ping shows 100% loss confirming isolation survived reboot of all three nodes; test address cleaned up

commands.command:
cat > /usr/local/bin/vlan-access-segmentation.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  ip link show eth1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && ip link show eth2 >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
  sleep 1
done

ip link show br0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || ip link add name br0 type bridge vlan_filtering 1
ip link set br0 up

ip addr flush dev eth1 scope global 2>/dev/null || true
ip addr flush dev eth2 scope global 2>/dev/null || true

ip link set eth1 master br0 2>/dev/null || true
ip link set eth2 master br0 2>/dev/null || true
ip link set eth1 up
ip link set eth2 up

bridge vlan del dev eth1 vid 1 2>/dev/null || true
bridge vlan del dev eth2 vid 1 2>/dev/null || true
bridge vlan add dev eth1 vid 10 pvid untagged 2>/dev/null || true
bridge vlan add dev eth2 vid 20 pvid untagged 2>/dev/null || true
bridge vlan add dev br0 vid 10 self 2>/dev/null || true
bridge vlan add dev br0 vid 20 self 2>/dev/null || true
bridge vlan del dev br0 vid 1 self 2>/dev/null || true

ip link show br0.10 >/dev/null 2>&1 || ip link add link br0 name br0.10 type vlan id 10
ip link show br0.20 >/dev/null 2>&1 || ip link add link br0 name br0.20 type vlan id 20
ip link set br0.10 up
ip link set br0.20 up
ip addr add 192.168.201.1/24 dev br0.10 2>/dev/null || true
ip addr add 192.168.202.1/24 dev br0.20 2>/dev/null || true
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/vlan-access-segmentation.sh
cat > /etc/systemd/system/vlan-access-segmentation.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Recreate VLAN access-port segmentation on node1
After=network.target interfaces-config.service
Wants=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/vlan-access-segmentation.sh
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable vlan-access-segmentation.service
echo done
commands.stdout:
Created symlink '/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/vlan-access-segmentation.service' → '/etc/systemd/system/vlan-access-segmentation.service'.
done
